property_summary: For any target and value where the target's fallback/receive consumes gas but does NOT revert (e.g. a contract that uses up gas and then returns), the reference C's sendMoney (using low-level call) will complete successfully (no revert) while the mutant using transfer may revert due to gas stipend limitations — so the property: calling sendMoney on such a gas-eating but non-reverting target always returns (ok == true) for the reference C, but the mutant can fail for some fuzzed amounts/targets.
change_summary: Change the low-level call to use transfer instead of call, which will revert on failure and may alter whether target receives funds or whether state (depositsCount) or caller sees change due to reversion.
